name: Stimgraph
one_liner: Explore saved material, connect ideas, and develop research questions grounded in your sources.
how_to_ingest: Read this JSON first. The recorded silent video and beats show the earlier Globe interface; the current default is Explore with trajectories, bridges, and the Research bench.

demo.scope: Legacy Globe demo; does not show the current Explore or Research bench.

what_it_shows.topic: Lime diamond. A named theme on saved posts.
what_it_shows.person: Filled dot. Bookmark author, or an account you follow.
what_it_shows.you: Ring at the pole. The owner of this map.
what_it_shows.following: Quieter person with no saved posts yet.
what_it_shows.scout: Cyan diamond. A suggested post, not a bookmark.
what_it_shows.affinity_link: Short dashes. Overlap across saves. Does not change ranking.
what_it_shows.follows_link: Longer dots. You follow this person. Heavier if they have no saves yet.

views.label: Explore
views.does: Default flat graph with LR/TB orientation, forward branches, a loop-free trail, and source reader. Includes trajectories, Bridge A → B, and Research bench.

views.label: Neighborhood
views.does: Nodes within N steps of the selection.

views.label: Combine
views.does: Your graph plus an imported .stimgraph neighborhood.

keyboard./_or_cmd_k: Open search. @ people, # topics, ~ following, : commands.
keyboard.arrows: Explore LR: up/down chooses, right follows, left goes back. Explore TB: left/right chooses, down follows, up goes back. Visible arrow controls match the orientation.

live_behavior.connect: OAuth read-only: bookmark.read, follows.read, tweet.read, users.read, offline.access. No write scopes.
live_behavior.sync: Pulls up to 600 bookmarks plus following. Streams pages as X returns them.
live_behavior.poll: Visible live tab polls the newest 15 bookmarks every 90 seconds. X has no bookmark webhook here.
live_behavior.enrich: Optional. Sends the next 40 bookmark texts and author handles to xAI. Never sends the X token. store: false.
live_behavior.scout: Optional. Searches X with x_search using top topics, frequent authors, and followed accounts. Optional 12-minute repeat while the tab stays open.
live_behavior.trajectories: Private saved path versions with questions, notes, resumable branches, and Markdown export.
live_behavior.bridges: Routes supported by shared bookmarks between concepts. Optional Grok interprets a supplied route; unverified directions stay separate.
live_behavior.research: Choose 2–8 bookmarks, a lens, and save-intent annotations. Write manually or explicitly ask Grok with up to 8 redacted 800-character excerpts; source quotations are checked. Cards keep questions, methods, assumptions, counterexamples, and a smallest investigation. Save private versions or export.
live_behavior.nearby_work: Explicit Crossref search sends only a reviewed query. Records up to five metadata results and the query time; it is not a full literature review or novelty claim.
live_behavior.identity: Prototype uses the connected X account as owner. Separate email app identity remains planned; see LAUNCH.md.

share_format.bridge_nodes: Matching people/topics in both graphs are highlighted.

beats.say: Stimgraph maps X bookmarks as a globe of topics, people, and saved posts. STIM means Stuff That Interests Me.
Drag to spin. Scroll to zoom. Hover to read names. Click a node to focus it.
The inspector shows why the node is here and the nodes one link away.
Press / or click search. Jump to a person, topic, post, or command.
Topics are lime diamonds. Click a row to fly the camera there.
Cyan diamonds are Grok suggestions from X, not bookmarks.
Grow a two-step neighborhood from the focus node. Export it as a .stimgraph file with no bookmark text.
Import another neighborhood. Matching people and topics become highlighted bridges.
Density, weakest visible link, motion, overlap links, labels, and color palettes. Saved on this device.
Same lime and cyan meaning on paper. Light and dark share one token set.
Connect X is read-only. Sync, Grok topic names, and scout are separate clicks.

mission: A private, user-directed graph explorer that turns personal bookmarks into useful paths, questions, and small investigations. AI drafts and external searches are explicit optional actions.
